observations.content:
This image displays the **Anvil Serving Dashboard**, a monitoring interface for GPU-based AI/ML serving infrastructure.

---

### 🖥️ **GPU Status Panel (Left)**
- **GPU Model**: `RTX 5090`
- **VRAM Used**: `30057 MiB` (~29.35 GB)
- **Serves Running**: `7`
- **Health Status**: ✅ **HEALTHY** (indicated by green dot and text)

---

### ⚠️ **Error Panel (Right)**
- **Error Code**: `Error 503`
- **Message**:  
  > No available tier for preset 'planning' - all candidates busy
- **Action Button**: `Retry` (blue button)

> This indicates that the system is unable to allocate resources for a request tagged with the “planning” preset because all available service tiers are currently occupied.

---

### 📊 **Requests per Tier (Bar Chart)**
Shows distribution of requests across three service tiers:
- **heavy** — Highest volume (tallest blue bar)
- **fast** — Medium volume (orange bar)
- **ocr** — Lowest volume (green bar)

---

### 🔍 Summary of Key Values & Status

| Category             | Value / Status                     |
|----------------------|------------------------------------|
| GPU                  | RTX 5090                           |
| VRAM Usage           | 30057 MiB                          |
| Active Serves        | 7                                  |
| System Health        | HEALTHY                            |
| Current Error        | 503 — All candidates busy          |
| Affected Preset      | ‘planning’                         |
| Request Distribution | heavy > fast > ocr                 |

---

### 💡 Interpretation
Despite the GPU being healthy and running 7 services, the system is experiencing resource contention — specifically, no free instances are available to handle new requests under the “planning” preset. The user may need to retry later or scale up capacity. The high load on the “heavy” tier suggests it’s the most demanded workload type.

--- 

✅ **Dashboard is functional but under pressure due to saturation in specific presets.**
